race.title: Play Lucky Stable With William Hill Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: BOOMBAWN ended last season in better heart than his form figures would suggest and, having shaped well on return over hurdles at Chepstow 4 weeks ago, Dan Skelton's charge could well be ready to exploit his reduced chase mark with first-time cheekpieces enlisted. Knight of Allen often shaped well himself last season and is another on the shortlist, with C&D winner Imperial Saint and Southoftheborder completing the shortlist. BOOMBAWN (IRE) KNIGHT OF ALLEN (FR) IMPERIAL SAINT (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Boombawn (11/4), Knight Of Allen (5/1), Imperial Saint (5/1), Josh The Boss (7/1), Bluey (8/1), Kings Jet (12/1), Rodney (12/1), Southoftheborder (12/1), Insurrection (14/1), Etalon (20/1), Hercule Du Seuil (20/1), Down Memory Lane (50/1)
